items.text: the Seed words row wears the Seed tile's sprout beside its word
the drawer under the bar is never empty: in Field and Touch it shows every source's sounds, grouped under each one's dot (Water, then your packs); a tap plays it and lights its source above
headings say the choice: Which way · Forward, Lands on · Beat, Every · 15 s, Moves · Breathe, Move · Sine
+ in the sound shelf is the pack's cube with a plus, and a pack's name sits in the normal ink

Settings › Words: Always, Learn or Never. Learn (the default) shows the words beside the icons and fades each one once you know that control; a finger brings it back. Never is icons only, for small children
the Pro padlocks sit top right and quiet
choose above, play below: Beats, Field and Touch and the source (Water, your packs, +) sit in the sound shelf above the bar; the drawer under the bar holds only what plays
the icon tiles give their words room: the Picture presets sit in two rows of four, and the Auto sources spread out
Random in the Picture presets: a new mix of moves at every tap
the Path strip lights the pattern on the field, and follows the robot and your picks
Auto's sources are pictures: sine, triangle, square, saw, noise and random as their waves; bass, mid and high as equalizer bars; beat, the finger and flow, each with its word
a crash report now says how much sound, picture and memory the page was holding, so long-play crashes on a phone can be found
the Picture panel keeps its margins and its band, and its presets are icons
a ring's switch is a menu icon (three lines), not a down caret
the word under the tempo circle sits centred, level with Every and Morph
the metronome is a chip at the end of Lands on, and clicks on the grid you pick there (every beat when off)
the Guide's Autoplay and Sound entries match the panels again; new entries for the Rings and for Sideways (show mode)
sideways on a phone, Scrub is on the bar, and a double tap on the stage scrubs too
when new scenes land on the beat (off, 8th, beat, half bar, bar) moved from the sound shelf to Autoplay, under Every
a tempo circle in Autoplay's Every row: tap it in time to set the tempo, drag up or down to nudge it, hold to let go
tap tempo left the sound shelf; tempo lives with Autoplay now (b still taps)
the metronome, the dot on the tempo circle: a click on every beat (Pro, open in the beta)
